superb.label: Superb
superb.description: An exceptional stamp in every respect. Extremely wide margins, perfectly centered, vibrant color, fresh gum, and outstanding overall quality.

extremely_fine.label: Extremely Fine (XF)
extremely_fine.description: A stamp that is exceptionally well-centered, with margins that are larger than normal. Fresh color and original gum (if applicable).

very_fine.label: Very Fine (VF)
very_fine.description: A stamp with good centering, full perforations, and attractive color. The standard for quality stamps.

fine_very_fine.label: Fine-Very Fine (F-VF)
fine_very_fine.description: Better than average centering. Design may be slightly closer to one edge.

fine.label: Fine (F)
fine.description: Design is noticeably off-center but design clears the perforations. Average condition.
fine.centering: design touches perforations on one side

very_good.label: Very Good (VG)
very_good.description: Design is off-center and may touch perforations on one or two sides.

good.label: Good (G)
good.description: Design may be cut into slightly by perforations. Acceptable for filling spaces.

average.label: Average (AVG)
average.description: Poor centering with design cut into by perforations. Space filler only.

mint_never_hinged.label: Mint Never Hinged
mint_never_hinged.description: Original gum with no trace of a hinge mark or disturbance. Full pristine gum.

original_gum.label: Original Gum
original_gum.description: Original gum that may have a hinge remnant or small disturbed area.

lightly_hinged.label: Lightly Hinged
lightly_hinged.description: Original gum with slight disturbance from a removed hinge. Minimal remnant.

hinged.label: Hinged
hinged.description: Original gum with visible hinge remnant or area of disturbance.

heavily_hinged.label: Heavily Hinged
heavily_hinged.description: Original gum with large hinge remnant or significant disturbance.

regummed.label: Regummed
regummed.description: Original gum has been replaced with new gum.

no_gum.label: No Gum
no_gum.description: Gum completely removed or never present (for unused stamps).

disturbed_gum.label: Disturbed Gum
disturbed_gum.description: Original gum with significant disturbance, cracks, or discoloration.

perfect.description: All perforations intact and evenly separated

minor_perf_fault.description: One or two short or missing perfs, or slight nibbed perfs

major_perf_fault.description: Many missing perfs or pulled perfs

straight_edge.description: One or more sides without perforations (sheet margin)

superb.description: Light, clear cancel that doesn't obscure design. Well-struck.

very_fine.description: Light cancel, may slightly touch design.

heavy.description: Heavy cancel covering much of design.

socked_on_nose.description: Cancel perfectly centered on stamp design.
socked_on_nose.note: May be premium for certain cancels

small_tear.description: Tear visible but doesn't affect design

definitive.description: Regular issue stamps for everyday use
